title: Scalable Heterogeneous Graph Foundation Models for Data-Driven Optimal Power Flow in Smart Grids
abstract: arXiv:2605.23194v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fast and reliable optimal power flow (OPF) approximation is important for power system operation, yet heterogeneous OPF graph models are often evaluated either with architecture-specific implementations or on limited training corpora. This paper presents a large-scale heterogeneous graph-learning workflow, built on HydraGNN, for data-driven OPF surrogate modeling and graph foundation-model (GFM) development. translated_title: 智能电网中数据驱动最优潮流的可扩展异构图基础模型
translated_abstract: 快速可靠的最优潮流（OPF）近似对电力系统运行至关重要，然而异构OPF图模型通常仅在特定架构的实现或有限的训练语料上进行评估。本文提出了一种基于HydraGNN的大规模异构图学习工作流，用于数据驱动的OPF代理建模和图基础模型（GFM）开发。该工作流保留了母线、发电机、负荷、并联支路、交流（AC）线路、变压器以及设备与母线之间的连接关系，并为分布式预处理、多图形处理器（GPU）训练、超参数优化（HPO）和下游适配提供了统一实现。使用来自十个PGLib-OPF（电力电网基准库交流最优潮流算法）案例的约三百万个异构图，涵盖14至13,659个母线的电网规模，我们比较了六种异构图神经网络……
tldr: 本文提出基于HydraGNN的大规模异构图学习工作流，利用约三百万个涵盖不同规模电网的异构图训练图基础模型，为智能电网数据驱动的最优潮流代理建模提供了可扩展的统一解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a scalable large-scale heterogeneous graph-learning workflow built on HydraGNN, which trains graph foundation models on approximately three million heterogeneous graphs spanning power grids of 14 to 13,659 buses, enabling fast and reliable data-driven optimal power flow approximation in smart grids.
